name: add_chat_member
description: Add one project member to a restricted chat's audience by email. The email must belong to a current member of the chat's project. Re-adding an existing member succeeds without change. The chat must already be restricted; other visibility levels respond 409.

email.description: the email of a current member of the chat's project

name: attach_label
description: Attach a label by name to an asset. Re-attaching an already-attached label is a no-op.

asset_id.description: the asset to attach the label to

label_name.description: the label name; a name with no matching label is auto-created

name: create_action
description: Create an action in the project. Prompt is plain text. Provide a schedule for recurring runs or a trigger for event-driven runs. An action always starts enabled.

name: create_chat
description: Create a chat with its first turn. intelligence picks a mode preset and provider biases vendor selection within it. Turns run asynchronously; set wait_for_response to block until the answer is ready, otherwise poll get_message with the returned message_id.

chat.description: prompt is required. intelligence is one of "auto", "fast", "expert", "research" and empty defaults to "auto". provider is one of "automatic", "anthropic", "openai", "google". An empty scope sees the whole project

wait_for_response.description: block until the turn finishes and the response is ready before returning

timeout_seconds.description: seconds to wait when wait_for_response is set; defaults to 360

name: create_label
description: Create a label in the project. Color, when set, must be a 6-digit hex code like #6b7280.

name: create_memory
description: Store a memory in the project. category is one of: identity, preference, fact, context, instruction. importance is an integer. scope is optional and, for now, only accepts "project".

name: create_project
description: Create a project. It lands in the org and workspace of the caller's root grant.

name: create_project_invitation
description: Invite one user to a project by email. role is one of "collaborator", "reader", "owner". The invitation email is sent automatically; the user becomes a member only after accepting. A project holds one invitation per role: when one already exists the email is added to it, and re-inviting an email already on it succeeds unchanged.

invitation.description: email is required. role is one of "collaborator", "reader", "owner"

name: create_share_link
description: Create a chat's public share link. Anyone with the URL can read the conversation without authentication. Each chat has at most one active link: when one already exists it is returned unchanged; use regenerate_share_link to rotate it.

name: create_skill
description: Create a skill in the project. scope is "project" or "user". category is "skill" or "persona". Content is the skill body.

name: delete_action
description: Delete an action permanently.

name: delete_asset
description: Delete an asset permanently.

name: delete_chat
description: Delete a chat and its messages permanently.

name: delete_label
description: Delete a label permanently. It is detached from every asset it was attached to.

name: delete_memory
description: Delete a memory permanently.

name: delete_message
description: Delete a single message from a chat permanently.

name: delete_project_invitation
description: Revoke a pending project invitation by ID.

project_id.description: the project the invitation belongs to

name: delete_session
description: Delete a session permanently.

name: delete_share_link
description: Revoke a chat's share link. The public URL stops working immediately. Responds 404 when no active link exists.

name: delete_skill
description: Delete a skill permanently. System skills are read-only.

name: detach_label
description: Detach a label from an asset by ID. Detaching a label that is not attached is a no-op.

asset_id.description: the asset to detach the label from

name: disable_action
description: Disable an action without deleting it, pausing its schedule or trigger.

name: disable_skill
description: Disable a skill for the caller so it is no longer offered during chats.

name: enable_action
description: Enable an action so it runs on its schedule or trigger.

name: enable_skill
description: Enable a skill for the caller so it is offered during chats.

name: get_action
description: Get a single action by ID, including its full schedule, trigger, scope, and email configuration.

name: get_asset
description: Get a single asset by ID, including its current ingest status.

name: get_chat
description: Get a chat's metadata by ID. modified_at is null until the chat's first turn completes.

name: get_label
description: Get a single label by ID, including its color and icon.

name: get_memory
description: Get a single memory by ID.

name: get_message
description: Get a single message by ID, including its prompt and response. Both stay empty until the async turn finishes, so poll until the response is present.

name: get_session
description: Get a single session by ID: its lifecycle state, live summary, and turn_count. Use it for what a session decided and what came out of it; for what was actually said (quotes, who said what, when), use get_session_transcript. state distinguishes a finished session (session.ended) from one still scheduled or running. The live summary is the canonical record of what the session decided: its items with kind todo are the follow-ups. The turns field is deprecated and will be removed; read the transcript with get_session_transcript.

name: get_session_transcript
description: Read one page of a session's transcript, oldest turn first: the words actually spoken, each turn with its index, speaker label, text, and m:ss timecode when the recording has one. Use it for quotes, who said what, or when something came up; use get_session for the outcome (live summary, todos). With no cursor it starts at the beginning of the meeting; before_id set to the session's turn_count (from get_session) returns the most recent turns. While has_more is true, pass last_id as after_id to read forward, or first_id as before_id to read backward. Pages hold up to 100 turns. Indices are stable once the session has ended (state session.ended); while it is still recording, turns merged from another device can shift them.

limit.description: turns per page, 1 to 100; defaults to 25

after_id.description: the previous page's last_id; returns the turns after that index

before_id.description: a turn index, or the session's turn_count for the most recent turns; returns the turns just before it, still oldest first

name: get_share_link
description: Get a chat's share-link status. url and created_at are empty when the chat isn't shared.

name: get_skill
description: Get a single skill by ID, including its content and enabled state for the caller.

name: list_actions
description: List the actions visible in the project, cursor-paginated. Use after_id / before_id with the returned first_id / last_id to page.

limit.description: maximum number of actions to return; the server clamps to its own bounds

after_id.description: page forward from this action ID

before_id.description: page backward from this action ID

name: list_assets
description: List assets in the project, cursor-paginated. Use after_id / before_id with the returned first_id / last_id to page.

limit.description: maximum number of assets to return; the server clamps to its own bounds

after_id.description: page forward from this asset ID

before_id.description: page backward from this asset ID

name: list_chat_members
description: List a restricted chat's audience. Use the returned user_id with remove_chat_member.

name: list_chats
description: List the caller's chats in the project, cursor-paginated. Use after_id / before_id with the returned first_id / last_id to page.

limit.description: maximum number of chats to return; the server clamps to its own bounds

after_id.description: page forward from this chat ID

before_id.description: page backward from this chat ID

name: list_labels
description: List the labels visible in the project, cursor-paginated. Use after_id / before_id with the returned first_id / last_id to page.

limit.description: maximum number of labels to return; the server clamps to its own bounds

after_id.description: page forward from this label ID

before_id.description: page backward from this label ID

name: list_memories
description: List the memories in the project, cursor-paginated. Use after_id / before_id with the returned first_id / last_id to page.

limit.description: maximum number of memories to return; the server clamps to its own bounds

after_id.description: page forward from this memory ID

before_id.description: page backward from this memory ID

name: list_messages
description: List metadata for every message in a chat. Message content is fetched separately via get_message.

name: list_project_members
description: List every user holding a grant in a project, with their role and how they joined.

name: list_projects
description: List the projects the API key can access. Project tools need only the API key, not the configured project ID.

name: list_sessions
description: List the caller's sessions in the project, newest first, cursor-paginated. Each item carries the session's lifecycle state, so finished sessions (state session.ended) can be picked out without fetching each one. Use after_id / before_id with the returned first_id / last_id to page.

limit.description: maximum number of sessions to return; the server clamps to its own bounds

after_id.description: page forward from this session ID

before_id.description: page backward from this session ID

name: list_skills
description: List the skills visible in the project, cursor-paginated, including each skill's enabled state for the caller. Use after_id / before_id with the returned first_id / last_id to page.

limit.description: maximum number of skills to return; the server clamps to its own bounds

after_id.description: page forward from this skill ID

before_id.description: page backward from this skill ID

name: regenerate_share_link
description: Revoke a chat's current share link, if any, and mint a new URL. The old URL stops working immediately.

name: remove_chat_member
description: Remove one user from a restricted chat's audience by user_id. The chat must already be restricted; other visibility levels respond 409.

user_id.description: the user to remove; use the user_id returned by list_chat_members

name: search_knowledge_base
description: Search the project's documents and return the passages that answer a question. Use this whenever the user asks about their own files, uploads, or project content, rather than guessing from memory. The search is semantic, so phrase the query as a natural question; keywords work poorly. Searches the whole project unless you pass asset_ids, label_ids, view_ids, or concept_ids. Each result carries an asset and its matching passages, best first, with a relevance_score from 0 to 1 where higher is a stronger match. Quote the passages rather than paraphrasing them, and cite the asset title. Requires a paid plan.

query.description: the question to answer, in natural language; this is a semantic search, so write a question rather than keywords

max_results.description: maximum passages to return, 1 to 50; defaults to 10

asset_ids.description: restrict the search to these assets; omit every list to search the whole project

label_ids.description: restrict the search to assets carrying these labels

view_ids.description: restrict the search to the assets in these views

concept_ids.description: restrict the search to the assets behind these concepts

indexed_only.description: skip the slower pass that reads documents still being ingested; set this when speed matters more than covering a just-uploaded file

name: send_message
description: Append a turn to an existing chat. The tuning fields match create_chat. Turns run asynchronously; set wait_for_response to block until the answer is ready, otherwise poll get_message with the returned message_id.

chat_id.description: the chat to append a turn to

message.description: prompt is required. The tuning fields match create_chat

wait_for_response.description: block until the turn finishes and the response is ready before returning

timeout_seconds.description: seconds to wait when wait_for_response is set; defaults to 360

name: set_chat_visibility
description: Set a chat's access level: "project" lets every project member read it, "restricted" limits reads to the owner plus the audience managed via the chat member tools, "private" is owner-only. Setting restricted keeps any audience the chat already had; switching to project or private clears it.

name: update_action
description: Replace an action's configuration. The body is a full replacement: any schedule, trigger, scope, or email section omitted from action is cleared.

action.description: the full replacement action body; omitted schedule, trigger, scope, or email sections are cleared

name: update_asset
description: Patch an asset's name and/or description. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

name.description: new display name; omit to leave unchanged

description.description: new description; omit to leave unchanged

name: update_chat
description: Rename a chat. title is the only mutable field and must not be empty.

chat.description: title is the only mutable field and must not be empty

name: update_label
description: Patch a label's display metadata. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Color, when set, must be a 6-digit hex code like #6b7280.

label.description: the patch; omitted fields are left unchanged. color, when set, must be a 6-digit hex code like #6b7280

name: update_memory
description: Update a memory. content is replaced; category and importance are optional patches. category is one of: identity, preference, fact, context, instruction.

memory.description: content is replaced; category and importance are optional patches. category is one of: identity, preference, fact, context, instruction

name: update_project
description: Replace a project's name and description — the only two mutable fields. The body is a full set, not a patch: an empty description clears it.

project.description: the full set of the two mutable fields, not a patch; an empty description clears it

name: update_session
description: Patch a session's name and/or description. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

session.description: name and/or description patch; omitted fields are left unchanged

name: update_skill
description: Patch a skill. Omitted fields are left unchanged. category, when set, must be "skill" or "persona". System skills are read-only.

skill.description: the patch; omitted fields are left unchanged. category, when set, must be "skill" or "persona"

name: upload_file
description: Upload a local file as an asset. The path is resolved on the host running this MCP server, so this is intended for local stdio usage; uploading inline content over remote HTTP is not yet supported. Returns the asset and whether its content already existed (a dedup hit).

path.description: absolute path to a local file, resolved on the host running this MCP server

wait_for_ready.description: block until the asset finishes ingesting before returning

timeout_seconds.description: seconds to wait when wait_for_ready is set; defaults to 120
